headline: Saudi Arabia cancels VA Tech Wabag's ₹2,332 crore Yanbu water project
summary: Saudi Arabia has cancelled a ₹2,332 crore project awarded to Indian water treatment firm VA Tech Wabag. The company is seeking formal clarity on the reasons behind the decision and next steps.
why: VA Tech Wabag is a major Indian engineering and water infrastructure provider listed on the NSE and BSE.

impacts.name: VA Tech Wabag
impacts.why: The cancellation of a major ₹2,332 crore overseas project directly reduces contract backlog.
